function_declarations.name: list_tenants
function_declarations.description: List all tenants (doctors and hospitals) currently in the platform.

function_declarations.name: read_content
function_declarations.description: Read the site configuration or a specific page for a tenant. Returns { site } or { site, page }.

pageSlug.description: Optional. Page slug to read (e.g. home). Omit to read only site config.

function_declarations.name: save_content
function_declarations.description: Save (create or update) the site configuration or a page for a tenant. Always call read_content first to get current data, then modify and save.

pageSlug.description: Optional. Page slug to save (e.g. home). Omit to save site config.

data.description: The full JSON object to write. For site config, include all settings. For page, include blocks and settings.

function_declarations.name: import_tenant
function_declarations.description: Create a completely new tenant from AI-generated JSON. Accepts site.json and page JSON as strings. Returns previewUrl on success.

site.description: Full site.json as a JSON string. Must include tenantId, tenantType, status, subscription, domains, profile, business, presentation, header, seo.

pages.description: Full page JSON as a JSON string. Can be a single page object or JSON array of pages. Must include blocks and settings arrays.

function_declarations.name: import_page
function_declarations.description: Add or replace a single page on an existing tenant. Returns previewUrl on success.

page.description: Full page JSON as a JSON string. Must include blocks and settings arrays.

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite existing page with same slug. Default true.

function_declarations.name: search_photos
function_declarations.description: Search for stock photos on Pexels. Use this to find images for doctor headshots, clinic interiors, hero backgrounds, etc.
